```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

league_df <- read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "laser_league_players.csv")) %>%
  mutate(high_glow = if_else(glow_rating >= 8, 1, 0))

glow_model <- glm(
  high_glow ~ matches_played + tag_accuracy_pct + shield_uptime_pct,
  data = league_df,
  family = binomial()
)
summary(glow_model)
```
